dependencies.mechanism: AI-server revenue scale is an input to profit-capture analysis, but demand durability and product margin require separate evidence.
dependencies.decision_effect: Profit-capture confidence cannot exceed the demand and attribution evidence boundary.

conflicts.tension: Observed AI-server revenue supports scale while current evidence does not establish durable demand or AI-server product profit.
conflicts.reason: The evidence is compatible rather than contradictory, but the missing durability and product-margin bridge prevents resolution.

gaps.impact: Prevents revenue scale from being treated as durable end-demand.
gaps.stop_condition: Stop after one bounded current Dell filing, earnings and investor-presentation route is exhausted.
gaps.next_evidence_route: Dell current filing, earnings release or investor presentation with orders, backlog, deployment or repeat demand.

gaps.impact: Prevents AI-server revenue from being converted into product profit or cash conclusions.
gaps.stop_condition: Stop when current Dell segment and product disclosures do not isolate AI-server margin or a reproducible mix bridge.
gaps.next_evidence_route: Dell segment note, earnings tables or investor presentation with AI-server profit or mix-to-margin authority.

dependencies.mechanism: HBM demand and wafer intensity can affect mix, capacity and capital needs before appearing in company revenue, margin and cash.
dependencies.decision_effect: Value-capture confidence depends on separating HBM economics from consolidated and conventional DRAM totals.

conflicts.tension: Current HBM demand is positive while the same capacity mechanism can increase conventional DRAM supply and pricing risk if HBM demand weakens.
conflicts.reason: Both mechanisms are supported as conditional pathways; current evidence does not establish which path dominates across the next cycle.

gaps.impact: Prevents consolidated revenue and DRAM facts from proving HBM revenue, profit, price-volume-mix or cash conversion.
gaps.stop_condition: Stop when current Micron product, segment and earnings disclosures do not isolate HBM economics or a reproducible bridge.
gaps.next_evidence_route: Micron product or segment disclosure with HBM revenue, profit, PVM, capex, inventory or cash authority.

dependencies.mechanism: Named cloud deployments and company revenue establish demand transmission before product-level economics can be assessed.
dependencies.decision_effect: Value-capture confidence requires product or Data Center attribution beyond consolidated totals.

conflicts.tension: Named deployments support current demand while the bounded source set contains no realized constraint evidence sufficient to validate or dismiss the counterthesis.
conflicts.reason: Absence of a realized constraint in the bounded source is a gap, not proof that the bottleneck is absent.

gaps.impact: Prevents consolidated revenue and profit from proving accelerator or Data Center product economics.
gaps.stop_condition: Stop when current NVIDIA segment and product disclosures do not isolate comparable product revenue and profit.
gaps.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA earnings tables, segment note or investor presentation with product economics authority.

gaps.impact: Prevents the Lead from resolving whether supply, export, deployment or concentration constraints are currently material.
gaps.stop_condition: Stop after bounded NVIDIA, named-counterparty and effective-policy official routes are exhausted.
gaps.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA, named-counterparty or effective-policy official source reporting a realized constraint or repeated bounded absence.
